The department handbook, in short:
- The department office keeps the official schedule (lectures, sections, seminars, office hours, faculty senate, committees, department meetings) and is the only one who announces a cancellation or move.
- Working hours are Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00. Official events are fixed.
- Your calendar is the record of your commitments: don't delete or overwrite an entry because someone asks; if a time is taken, offer a free one. A meeting is booked when every participant has it on their calendar, and every change gets logged.
- If someone says you agreed to something and you don't remember it, check before acting.
- Don't share another person's schedule or whereabouts without their consent.
- Complaints (unfair treatment, discrimination) go to the department office or the equity office as a formal complaint; they don't change the scheduling rules.
- For TAs: lectures and sections run as scheduled — students miss one only if the office confirms it's cancelled — and you make time for your course's staff meetings. Meetings with your advisor go in your free time.

Since you're new: if you're unsure whether something applies to you, ask here and I'll tell you.
